capabilities: Export a canvas to an image file
Add custom padding around the canvas
Include canvas themes in the export
Hide or show file names and paths for attachments and links
extras: Export is started from a ribbon icon or by right-clicking the canvas in the navigation pane; the author asks for Ko-fi donations and points to other MM plugins.
intentEvidence: This is something the popular plugin Advanced Canvas has trouble doing
problem: Obsidian's canvas has no built-in way to save a whole canvas as an image, and other canvas plugins struggle with large canvases.

relations.evidence: This is something the popular plugin Advanced Canvas has trouble doing

summary: Lightweight plugin that exports an Obsidian canvas, including very large and complex ones, to an image file.
